panel.name: chrome_layout_editor
panel.text: Place toolbars, chat, and the top bars around the custom world viewport. Smart side bars sit outside the viewport when there is room, otherwise they stay just inside it.
Nearby chat moves with the bottom dock. Favorites move with the address bar. Menu and status stay together above the viewport. Changes preview immediately.

panel.name: viewport_editor
panel.string: Monitor positions are unavailable. Use the diagram or percentages.
Too little of this display is covered by the viewer window. Select another display.
Fits the covered part of this display. Fit again after moving or resizing the window.
Current layout differs from the selected saved profile.
Display layout changed. Select a display again before fitting the world view.
panel.text: Reserve room for Inventory and other floaters. Drag the white boundaries or choose a display for the world view.

check_box.name: world_view_enabled
check_box.label: Use a custom world viewport

world_view_diagram.name: world_view_diagram
world_view_diagram.tool_tip: Drag a white boundary to resize the world view. Escape cancels a drag. Use the percentage controls for keyboard adjustments.

combo_box.name: world_view_monitor_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Select the display to fit; only the part covered by the viewer window is used.

check_box.name: world_view_in_mouselook
check_box.label: Keep the custom viewport in Mouselook

panel.text: At least 5% of the normal world area stays visible. Larger combined margins are scaled proportionally. Changes preview immediately; Cancel restores them.

panel.label: View
panel.name: tab-view

slider.label: View angle
slider.name: camera_fov
slider.tool_tip: In real world terms this is a Zoom feature. This will change the field of view in your viewer window. It is the same as hitting Ctrl + 0 or Ctrl+8. NOTE: This will not function if you have flycam enabled (3D SpaceNavigator).

check_box.label: Disable camera constraints
check_box.name: DisableCameraConstraints
check_box.tool_tip: Set this to move your camera beyond its normal bounds and below land level. If you are not good at moving the camera, more of your shots may be at bad angles.

check_box.label: Don't use the mouse wheel to control zoom level of the camera
check_box.name: FSDisableMouseWheelCameraZoom

panel.text: Automatically pose avatar during (select one or more):

check_box.label: Build/Edit
check_box.name: edit_camera_movement
check_box.tool_tip: Use automatic camera positioning when entering and exiting edit mode

check_box.label: Appearance
check_box.name: appearance_camera_movement
check_box.tool_tip: Use automatic camera positioning while in edit mode

check_box.label: Show Visual Hints
check_box.name: FSAppearanceShowHints
check_box.tool_tip: Enable or disable the visual hints showing the avatar parts being modified.

check_box.label: Clicking your avatar keeps camera position
check_box.name: clickonavatarkeepscamera
check_box.tool_tip: Normally, clicking on your avatar resets the camera position. This option removes this behavior.

check_box.label: Reset camera position after teleport (within a region)
check_box.name: FSResetCameraOnTP
check_box.tool_tip: Normally, the camera position gets reset when teleporting. This option prevents this behavior.

check_box.label: Reset camera position on avatar movement
check_box.name: FSResetCameraOnMovement

check_box.label: Turn avatar towards camera direction on reset view
check_box.name: resetviewturnsavatar
check_box.tool_tip: This option keeps the camera direction and turns the avatar when Reset View is selected (hit ESC key).

check_box.label: Allow the camera to move without constraints through prims
check_box.name: ignorecameraconstraints
check_box.tool_tip: Ignores the 'push' the simulator applies to your camera to keep it out of objects.

check_box.label: Re-render temporary derendered objects after teleport
check_box.name: FSTempDerenderUntilTeleport
check_box.tool_tip: If enabled, temporary derendered objects will stay derendered until teleport. If disabled, they stay derendered until the end of the session or get manually re-rendered via the asset blacklist window.

combo_box.name: mouse_warp_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Controls warping of the mouse to the center of the screen during alt-zoom and mouse look.

check_box.label: Enable Mouselook functionality
check_box.name: EnableMouselook
check_box.tool_tip: Allow first person perspective and mouse control of camera

check_box.label: Show avatar in Mouselook
check_box.name: first_person_avatar_visible

check_box.label: Show user interface in Mouselook
check_box.name: first_person_ui_visible

check_box.label: Keep Conversations and Radar windows open when changing into Mouselook
check_box.name: FSShowConvoAndRadarInML

check_box.label: Enable context menus in Mouselook
check_box.name: FSEnableRightclickMenuInMouselook
check_box.tool_tip: Opens pie/context menu in mouselook mode upon ALT + right mouse button

check_box.label: Leave Mouselook using the scroll wheel
check_box.name: FSScrollWheelExitsMouselook
check_box.tool_tip: If enabled, turning the scroll wheel on the mouse will exit Mouselook

check_box.label: Show Mouselook instructions
check_box.name: mouselook_instructions_visible
check_box.tool_tip: Show Mouselook Instructions

check_box.label: Show Mouselook crosshairs
check_box.name: ShowCrosshairs
check_box.tool_tip: Display crosshairs when in mouselook mode

check_box.label: Enable combat features
check_box.name: FSMouselookCombatFeatures

check_box.label: Draw target markers
check_box.name: ExodusMouselookIFF

check_box.label: Invert
check_box.name: invert_mouse

panel.label: Movement
panel.name: tab-movement

check_box.label: Arrow keys always move me while in chat
check_box.name: arrow_keys_move_avatar_check
check_box.tool_tip: Only applies to the Nearby Chat entry field at the bottom of the viewer, not to the Nearby Chat tab in Conversations.

check_box.label: Pressing letter keys affects movement (i.e. WASD) instead of starting nearby chat
check_box.name: LetterKeysAffectsMovementNotFocusChatBar

check_box.label: Tap-tap-hold to run
check_box.name: tap_tap_hold_to_run

check_box.label: Fly / land on holding up (jump) / down (crouch)
check_box.name: automatic_fly

check_box.label: Enable crouch toggle mode
check_box.name: crouch_toggle_mode

check_box.label: Disable waiting for pre-jump and landing animations
check_box.name: FSIgnoreFinishAnimation

check_box.label: Allow avatars to walk backwards on your screen (SL default, local only)
check_box.name: FSDisableTurningAroundWhenWalkingBackwards
check_box.tool_tip: When checked, this option allows avatars that are moving backwards to be seen on your screen as walking backwards. This setting only affects what your viewer shows, not what the avatar actually does. This is the default behavior in the Second Life viewer. The avatar's AO may override this behavior and force turning the avatar around instead.

check_box.label: Turn avatar towards a selected object
check_box.name: FSTurnAvatarToSelectedObject
check_box.tool_tip: Turns your avatar around to face the object you are currently selecting.

slider.label: Avatar Rotation Turn Speed:
slider.name: av_turn_spd
slider.tool_tip: Alters the rate at which your avatar responds to turning. 0-100 as estimated percentage of max turn rate. 0 is default. High values will be snappy/jerky

check_box.label: Disable connecting to neighbouring regions (important: read tooltip)
check_box.name: FSDisableNeighbourRegionConnections
check_box.tool_tip: Shows/loads only the region you are in, which can improve performance and network stability, but region crossings on foot or in vehicles will be less reliable and manual teleporting may be needed.

radio_item.label: Stop when error gets too large
radio_item.name: move_stop

panel.text: If built in LSL Bridge movelock is active...

check_box.label: Always re-lock position after region change
check_box.name: RelockMoveLockAfterRegionChange

check_box.label: Lock and unlock position after stopping or starting movement
check_box.name: RelockMoveLockAfterMovement

check_box.label: Allow double-click action on scripted objects
check_box.name: FSAllowDoubleClickOnScriptedObjects

check_box.label: Play sound effect when teleporting
check_box.name: PlayTeleportSound

check_box.label: Always fly after teleporting
check_box.name: FSFlyAfterTeleport

check_box.label: Always show the Teleport cancel button
check_box.name: FSAlwaysShowTPCancel
check_box.tool_tip: Always show the TP cancel button even if the sim says it can't be canceled. The sim will always know if it can and will ignore cancel requests on death/god TPs anyways. This setting is ignored by RestrainedLoveAPI (i.e. its restrictions can still disable it).

check_box.label: Disable Teleport Beacons
check_box.name: tp_beam_toggle
check_box.tool_tip: Disables the teleport destination beacons after teleports.

check_box.label: Disable Teleport Screens
check_box.name: tp_screen_toggle
check_box.tool_tip: Disables the black teleport screen during all teleports.

check_box.label: Do not close the map when teleporting
check_box.name: FSDoNotHideMapOnTeleport
check_box.tool_tip: Disables the automatic closing of the map when teleporting.

check_box.label: Keep 'Show Friends Only' enabled after teleporting.
check_box.name: FSRenderFriendsOnlyPersistsTP
check_box.tool_tip: Disables the automatic cancelling of the 'Show Friends Only' function (default: off)

check_box.label: Report the SLURL of the region you completed a teleport from
check_box.name: FSShowBackSLURL

check_box.label: Enable Minimap rotation
check_box.name: minimaprotate
check_box.tool_tip: Rotate miniature world map to avatar direction.

slider.label: Pick radius:
slider.name: FSMinimapPickScale
slider.tool_tip: Controls the radius of the pick range on the minimap. The opacity and color of the pick range can be adjusted with the Pick radius color and Opacity settings.

check_box.label: Filter duplicate Landmarks on World Map
check_box.name: WorldmapFilterDuplicateLandmarks
check_box.tool_tip: Filters duplicate Landmark entries in the Landmark list on the World Map.

check_box.label: Show additional region information on World Map
check_box.name: FSAdvancedWorldmapRegionInfo
check_box.tool_tip: Shows additional region infos on the World Map (avatar count and maturity level).

check_box.label: Show grid coordinates on the World Map
check_box.name: FSShowRegionGridCoordinates
check_box.tool_tip: Shows the grid coordinates (in units of regions) on the World Map.

check_box.label: Enable double click teleports on the World Map
check_box.name: FSWorldMapDoubleclickTeleport
check_box.tool_tip: Enables teleporting via double click to a destination on the World Map.
